content: Written 2026-10-07 19:45. Real row 4 RB2 = code ab75b60, stage B from v9's A checkpoint with A's P41 depth scale 0.0406 added to the layer prior (the value session_end.depth_scale gave on A's stored frames in real_row4 and real_row4v2; v9's A ran without it); flags as RB: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --no-closed-background --ray-band --dataset real --resume --sessions ab.

The only change against RB (7ba58f8): the band of an earlier session's keyframe carries the fork's cross-session term, tau(q) = sigma(q) + error_per_metre q, session_refusion.cpp:1276 (tauOf(half, q) + error_per_metre q); error_per_metre = |s_now| + max |s_prev|, session_refusion.cpp:1254-1262 ('The position error two sessions' measured depth scales explain per metre of range: a reading scaled by (1 + s) is displaced by |s| q along its ray'). RB had only sigma(q): a port deviation from the fork (supervisor 19:42).

s = depthScale (P41, session_refusion.cpp:377-477; session_end.depth_scale), the layer's existing estimator, no new constant: s_now on this session's stored frames in every round, s_prev carried. sigma(q) unchanged (P37 estimator).
real_row4rb2/{checkpoint_b.pt, session_b/timeline.pkl, session_b/layer_log.txt (DEPTH_SCALE_ONLINE per round), run.json}, eval_real.

smoke_rb2_real (B 300 frames): no error, 2.8 frames/s (RB 3.1). Offline band check (analysis/band_check_v9_kftime.json; A keyframes against v9's map of their own time, e = 0.070/m): share of A pixels outside the band 0.435 -> 0.209, at 3.5-4.5 m 0.39 -> 0.05-0.07; mean pull 9.8 -> 7.1 cm.
~25 min B + ~5 min eval; disk ~370 GB used inside.
B background explained by the map (object_explained.py, GT-free) back from RB's 80.8% toward v9's 88.5%; official B G1 F1 above RB's 90.73; whether above 93.61 is open.
